{{Quote|The Hapans have had a compound on Dathomir for many years. Their old Queen Mother was Dathomiri, and their current one is half Dathomiri. Tasander was brought here as a boy by his father and chose to stay when his father left.|Kaminne Sihn|<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
A [[Hapan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''father''' of [[Tasander Dest]], founder of the [[Broken Columns Clan]]. Sometime after [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], when the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witch]] [[Teneniel Djo]] married the Hapan [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]], a Hapan compound was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where Tasander Dest's father brought his family to settle. After a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]], his father decided to leave, but Dest chose to remain on the planet and eventually founded the Broken Columns Clan.<ref name="Backlash" />
